<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916972_theRebbe_524" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916972_theRebbe_524__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the commandment to build a Sanctuary applies to all Temples, and that the main drawing down of the Divine Presence is achieved through service beyond measure and limitation, which will build the Third Temple.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And it is known,</t>
    <t s="2">that the commandment "And they shall make Me a Sanctuary" applies also to the Sanctuary,</t>
    <t s="3">the First Temple, the Second Temple,</t>
    <t s="4">and also the Third Holy Temple that will be built speedily in our days.</t>
    <t s="5">And from this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="6">that just as the drawing down of the main Shechinah in the Mishkan was through the service that is above measure and limitation,</t>
    <t s="7">the folly of holiness that is above reason and understanding,</t>
    <t s="8">so too is it regarding the drawing down of the main Shechinah in the Holy Temple,</t>
    <t s="9">that this is accomplished through the service of the folly of holiness that is above measure and limitation.</t>
    <t s="10">For through our actions and our service during the time of exile in a manner of the folly of holiness that is above reason and understanding,</t>
    <t s="11">through this, "And they shall make Me,"</t>
    <t s="12">the making of the Third Holy Temple that will be built speedily in our days,</t>
    <t s="13">which will be even more elevated than the Mishkan and the First and Second Temples,</t>
    <t s="14">"The Sanctuary, My Lord, which Your hands established."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that Israel is called the "Hosts of G-d" because their service must be like an army, without calculations based on reason and understanding, but with the folly of holiness.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is what Israel is called by the name "Hosts of G-d"</t>
    <t s="2">throughout all the generations,</t>
    <t s="3">for each and every Jew is a soldier in the hosts of G-d,</t>
    <t s="4">who goes out as an army to war,</t>
    <t s="5">to conquer the world and make it a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="6">And this that Israel is called by the name "Hosts of G-d"</t>
    <t s="7">(specifically "hosts")</t>
    <t s="8">is to indicate,</t>
    <t s="9">that their service must be in a manner that they do not take into account calculations according to reason and understanding,</t>
    <t s="10">the folly of holiness that is above reason and understanding,</t>
    <t s="11">similar to a literal army.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that just as a king spends all his treasuries to win a war, so too G-d gives the hosts of Israel the supernal treasures in a manner of squandering, without calculation, because the root of victory is in the innerness of Kesser, where no calculations exist.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And the Maamar continues,</t>
    <t s="2">that just as in a physical war,</t>
    <t s="3">in order to win the war, the king spends all the treasuries that were amassed over many years from generation to generation,</t>
    <t s="4">for although in the ordinary way, not only are they not used</t>
    <t s="5">(even for a great need)</t>
    <t s="6">but furthermore,</t>
    <t s="7">they are hidden and concealed from the eye of every beholder,</t>
    <t s="8">nevertheless, in order to defeat the opponent,</t>
    <t s="9">not only are the treasuries used, but they are even squandered,</t>
    <t s="10">for squandering is above calculation, measure, and limitation,</t>
    <t s="11">and the reason for this is that victory is rooted in the essence of the soul of that place</t>
    <t s="12">(in the essence of the soul)</t>
    <t s="13">where no calculations apply,</t>
    <t s="14">so too is it above,</t>
    <t s="15">that in order for the hosts of G-d to win the war,</t>
    <t s="16">to conquer the world and make it a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="17">they are given the aspect of the supernal treasure,</t>
    <t s="18">and moreover,</t>
    <t s="19">the giving of the treasures to them is in a manner of squandering,</t>
    <t s="20">above calculation.</t>
    <t s="21">And although even in giving</t>
    <t s="22">(in the ordinary way)</t>
    <t s="23">they said,</t>
    <t s="24">"Whoever gives, gives with a generous eye,"</t>
    <t s="25">nevertheless, even a "generous eye" is a description of measure and limitation,</t>
    <t s="26">but when the giving is in a manner of squandering,</t>
    <t s="27">there are no limitations in it.</t>
    <t s="28">And the reason for this</t>
    <t s="29">(that in order for the hosts of G-d to win the war,</t>
    <t s="30">they are given the treasures and in a manner of squandering)</t>
    <t s="31">is,</t>
    <t s="32">because the root of victory is in the innerness of Kesser,</t>
    <t s="33">for there</t>
    <t s="34">(in the innerness of Kesser)</t>
    <t s="35">no calculations apply.</t>
    <t s="36">And although the giving of the treasures in a manner of squandering is through the ministers and commanders of the war,</t>
    <t s="37">the Nesi'im of Israel in each generation,</t>
    <t s="38">up to the Nasi of our generation, the Baal HaHilula,</t>
    <t s="39">nevertheless, the main intention in this is that the treasures be drawn down and given to the men of valor,</t>
    <t s="40">the hosts of G-d,</t>
    <t s="41">through whom the victory is actually accomplished.</t>
    <t s="42">And this is also that the victory that will be through the service of the hosts of G-d</t>
    <t s="43">(in the Third Holy Temple)</t>
    <t s="44">is an eternal victory</t>
    <t s="45">("G-d shall reign forever and ever"),</t>
    <t s="46">for since the empowerment for their service is from the innerness of Kesser,</t>
    <t s="47">for in the innerness of Kesser the matter of changes does not apply,</t>
    <t s="48">therefore also the service of the hosts of G-d is with strong force without changes,</t>
    <t s="49">and consequently, also the victory through this service is eternal, in which cessation and change do not apply.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
